in_sanskrit.name: Ashavin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Love and Protection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashavin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashavin is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Asa' meaning 'Love' and 'Vin' meaning 'Protection'. He is a God worshipped for love, protection, and wisdom. Ashavin is also known as the god of love and is believed to be the protector of lovers.
